_comment: Fault-free baseline benchmark: re-validates raft vs the three netelect variants after the implementation changes (WithNetElect honoring enabled, penalty-based petition trigger, penalty-margin gate, [leader_elected] logging). No latency injection, so all nodes are equal and netelect should NOT migrate or petition — this isolates the steady-state OVERHEAD of the netelect machinery (ping/penalty loops) vs plain raft. Results to results/<label>/{mixed,read}/<run>/ with per-node server logs + timeseries.
